description.value: A private RV resort on the sandy shores of Tucelnuit Lake near Oliver, with a willow-shaded beach, dock, kayak and paddleboard rentals, and year-round operation; rates and site types listed are RV hook-ups only, with no tent or walk-in option apparent.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is an RV park on Tucelnuit Lake near Oliver, BC, open year-round. Amenities page explicitly lists coin-operated showers and flush toilets, coin laundry, WIFI on all RV sites, and pet-friendly policy. The 'BOOK NOW' button and 'Call to Reserve' text confirm reservations are accepted. No mention of tent sites, hiker/biker sites, or any accommodation for cyclists without an RV (aside from two rental trailers). OSM name says 'Apple Beach RV Park' while the website footer consistently says 'Apple Beach RV Resort'.
concerns: OSM name is 'Apple Beach RV Park' but website footer consistently uses 'Apple Beach RV Resort'
No tent or hiker/biker sites mentioned; all listed sites are full-hookup RV sites (30-amp power/water/sewer)
OSM record has no address or phone; values sourced from website contact page
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Primarily an RV park with no mention of tent camping or hiker/biker sites. A touring cyclist without an RV would need to rent one of two on-site trailers. Should be confirmed whether walk-in tent camping is accepted before including in a cycling directory.
